intent: Ten individual transcript-preparation tasks cover all four exposed scripts: live final-time placement, proposal/change/acceptance ordering, exact waiting location, changed poster location and reason, opposite bottle/lunch pictures with responsibility evidence, fill-before-departure scope, current bus number and the old-route pronoun. A fresh new-speaker transcript changes both time and place; audio-pending and zero-listening-credit boundaries are explicit.
picturePurpose: Original bottle/lunch panels support opposite self-bring versus school-provided matches. Roles are established only by literal notice quotes, never by artwork. Time/place/route attempts and negotiation stages are exact code models.

explanation.strategy: 先分开最初提议与改口，再核对接受回应；时间和地点都必须跟着最终安排。

steps.text: Eva用instead改约ten past five，即5:10，并提出社区活动中心门口。
steps.reason: 4:20和体育中心出现在Rui最初的提议中，不能因为先出现就保留成最终安排。

steps.text: Rui用That works for me接受改约，因此选5:10、社区活动中心门口。
steps.reason: 只改时间或只改地点都不完整；这仍是读文字的准备练习，不记录为听力表现。

distractors.reason: 地点跟着改约变了，时间却停在最初的4:20；没有同时保留Eva的新时间。
时间5:10正确，地点却还用最初的体育中心；Eva改约的是社区活动中心门口。

explanation.pitfall: 提议、改口和同意要连起来；一句里出现过的时间或地点，不一定是最后答案。
